FAQ

Frequently asked questions. Remaining questions or issues: contact@eraformaudio.com
Are future updates free?

Yes. Fraction is a one-time payment and any future updates will be totally free for all registered users.

We continuously update Fraction everytime we can, shaped by what our community needs next!

Each update, comes with new presets at no extra cost, so your Library grows over time. Every now and then, we will also release optional paid premium expansions.
Where can I watch a full overview of how Fraction works?

You can check out our full Fraction overview here.

Viom regularly posts videos on his YouTube channel showcasing Fraction in action.

+ if you search “Fraction VST” on YouTube, you’ll find plenty of reviews and videos you can watch!
What does the XY Pad in the middle do?

Left and Right (X) blends between sound layer A and B while Up and Down (Y) is split into two sections: 

Up and down in the bottom half of the XY Pad, controls the dry and wet of the effects page (0 - 75%).
When you go from the bottom to the top half of the XY Pad, that is where the Filter turns on in the advanced page.

Up and down in the top half of the XY Pad, controls the strength of the LFOs being applied to the Filter.

click here to watch a 60 seconds breakdown of Fraction.
Errors
My License Key is not working.

Copy and paste your License Key with no extra spaces at the end.

Find your license key in the “Your Download Is Ready!” email or log into our License Hub
If you got the issue where the plugin asks you to re-enter your license, then follow these steps:

Please try to reinstall fraction after closing it to see if its solves the issue, if not try the following steps:

Try to restart your mac or clear the files located at: '/Users/YOUR NAME/Library/Application Support/Prototype Audio/Fraction'
My Expansions are not loading into Fraction.

99% of the time it is about subfolders. Your "Expansions" folder needs to look like this.

1. Download and unzip the 26GB Expansions file (store it anywhere on your computer).
2. Bottom left of the Plugin → Settings → Sample Path, and select the “Expansions” folder inside the Factory Content folder.

Restart the VST.

Important: The folder your locating must be exactly named “Expansions” for them to show up in the preset browser.

The "Expansions" folder is also where any of your new Expansions are going into like Monuments or Core-Synth. But make sure there are no subfolders otherwise it won't show up.

Fraction won't show up in my DAW.

Run the correct installer for your operating system and the Fraction VST file will go to these places: 

WIN: C:/Program Files/Common Files/VST3 

MAC: C:/Program Files/Common Files/Components

and then make sure your DAW scans these folders (even tho it already does that per default).

Compatibility
What DAWs are supported and what are the system requirements?

Fraction works in any DAW that supports VST3 or AU formats, including FL Studio, Ableton Live, Logic Pro, Studio One,
Reaper, GarageBand and more...

It works on macOS 10.9+ and Windows 10+

Factory Expansion Content: 24.6 zip.file
→ 51.0GB minimum disk space required during unzipping
How much Disk-Space do I need to Install Fraction?

The factory expansion content that comes with your purchase contains all sounds and presets for Fraction.

Minimum required disk space: 51.4 GB You will receive a 25.7 GB ZIP file (that you can delete after zipping) + VST3 and AU installers.

click here to visit our support page with the guides to Fraction.
Can I use my Fraction License on my laptop and studio PC?

Yes! You can activate Fraction on up to 3 of your own devices per license.

If we detect unusual activity or the license being shared that aren’t recognized as your own devices, it may result in the license being restricted to a single active device.
